pairing.reference: the glass0.5 fixture is the reference side of every pair: its silhouette masks the material rows, and every signed reading is [glass0.5, glass0.25]
pairing.bar: per cell and metric, the LARGER of the two sides' three-level bounds (the cell's own pairwise max over its seven runs, else that bed's smallest non-zero pairwise max, else zero); moved means the pair's value exceeds it

construction: (glass0.25 inactive − glass0.25 active) − (glass0.5 inactive − glass0.5 active), per signed capture reading. Each side's bar is the sum of its two cells' run-to-run spreads with the native delta's bed-minimum fallback; the verdict bar is the larger side's.
